title: Trump Media faces a Nov. 30 deadline to repay up to $1B in convertible bonds sold last May to fund a "bitcoin treasury," as its shares are down 60+% this year (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Trump Media faces a Nov. 30 deadline to repay up to $1B in convertible bonds sold last May to fund a “bitcoin treasury,” as its shares are down 60+% this year — Plunge in shares and cryptocurrency prices could force Truth Social owner to sell assets or take on costly new debt
